title: 第11章 初试御剑术第12章 剑山秘境
content_zh:
“虎哥别等了直接上将这条蛟龙围杀了！”狩猎队中一个人说道。
王虎点了点头，对着小个子说道“汪强你看住那个女的我们对付这条蛟龙。”
话落王虎提着一柄重剑向前，狩猎队的成员也跟随他摆好了阵势，从四个方向将蛟龙围住。
郑元雪见状赶忙从储物戒中取出回灵丹想扔给蛟龙让他恢复灵气，但是还没等他扔出去小个子汪强便走了过来挡在她与蛟龙之间，随后身形一闪出现在郑元雪身边从储物戒中取出绳子将郑元雪双手束缚住，郑元雪想挣扎也没有办法，普通人在修士面前还是太弱小了，汪强在用绳子绑住郑元雪的时候看到了躺在地上的杨修，心中虽然有点疑惑但是看到人是昏迷的便没有多想将目光落到了主战场。
“虎哥我们拖住他的四肢你来攻击！”狩猎队中一个女人开口对虎哥说道。
王虎紧握重剑站在蛟龙身前开口“好！小娜你们多注意，虽然这蛟龙受伤但是实力还是蛮强的。”
“好”林小娜手握长鞭子回应了一声便向蛟龙抽去。
蛟龙见四人靠近，先一尾巴将身后的手持长剑的敌人击退，再挥动没受伤的右爪向左侧拿刀敌人抓去。
左侧男子见状本来刺过去的刀被他横在身前格挡蛟龙的攻击，他修为是狩猎队中除了汪强最低的，蛟龙这一攻击讲他反震退数步，口中和喉咙中带着铁锈味。
在蛟龙右侧的林小娜看到蛟龙挥动左爪攻击右侧的叶安，本来抽向蛟龙左爪的鞭子抽到了蛟龙背部弹开，见状林小娜再次挥鞭再次向蛟龙抽了回去。
王虎和其他人都不一样他是举起重剑直接向蛟龙的头部劈去，而蛟龙一口便咬住他的重剑甩动头颅将重剑连同王虎甩了出去，王虎的实力是四人中最强的，虽然被甩出去但是很快便稳住了身形。
蛟龙在击退虎哥时发现了再次攻击而来的林小娜，刚才她那一鞭抽在自己防御力极强的背部鳞片上给自己的感觉像是在挠痒，但是第二鞭攻击的地方是它的腹部，而且这一鞭威力比刚才那一鞭还强，大脑判断不能让这一鞭击中，随后挥动尾巴将这一鞭化解顺势也将尾巴抽向林小娜。
林小娜见状赶快后退躲过攻击，刚才那一尾巴的感觉让人十分的心悸，虽然没中但是带来的劲风让她清楚了这条蛟龙的实力比他们推断的还要更强一点，她目光看向虎哥。
刚才蛟龙化解攻击让狩猎队众人内心不安起来。
与狩猎队不一样蛟龙化解完攻击信心大增，但是也不想恶斗便发出声音“现在退去还可以留尔等性命！”
王虎听到蛟龙的声音大笑了说道“我们狩猎队猎杀妖兽本就是刀口舔血，小娜别攻击了，用鞭子控制住它的左爪，路一山牵制住他的尾巴，我牵制他的头部，叶安这次你来攻击。”
林小娜听到王虎的话语结合刚刚的攻击推断出腹部是蛟龙的弱点便开口补充道“叶安，攻击它的腹部那里是它的弱点。”
叶安听到王虎和林小娜的话语伸手擦了擦嘴角的鲜血大声回应一句“知道了！”
刚才众人的攻击让把郑元雪控制住的汪强也开口“虎哥要不要我也帮忙围杀？”
王虎听到了汪强的话说“不用，你的任务就是看好那个女人！”

经过刚刚的沟通四人同时出手，林小娜用鞭子控制住蛟龙左爪，路一山和王虎两人断对着蛟龙的头和尾巴攻击迫使蛟龙不得不用尾巴和嘴巴用应付二人，右侧的叶安轻松便来到蛟龙身旁挥刀向蛟龙腹部攻击，蛟龙右爪受伤了没有完全失去了应对这攻击的能力，刀最终砍在了蛟龙腹部，蛟龙吃痛一声挣扎的力度变大左爪甩开了林小娜的鞭子向叶安攻去，叶安没有贪刀砍中一刀就身形倒退离开了蛟龙的攻击范围，林小娜见状挥鞭向蛟龙面门抽去，想攻击蛟龙眼睛，但是蛟龙头颅动了一下这一击打在了鼻子上。
王虎看到攻击有效很开心手中重剑不停攻击嘴里大喊“攻击有效！我和路一山还是照常，林小娜和叶安你俩看准时机攻击！”
蛟龙在众人围攻下身躯不断受伤，这让在一旁被捆绑住的郑元雪心里异常不安，身旁的汪强看到小队占上风非常开心面容上满是笑意。
“呼～”躺在地上的杨修深呼一口气缓缓睁开眼起身。映入眼帘的是被捆住的郑元雪还有被围杀的蛟龙，他赶忙站起身来，手中的龙血剑胚也和意识中一样从剑胚蜕变成了一柄剑。
杨修起身的声音把汪强吓了一跳，还未等汪强开口一柄剑便凌空将他的头部斩落在地，随后杨修的声音便从郑元雪身后传来“你先用这把剑割断绳子我去支援蛟龙！”
汪强刚刚在郑元雪身侧死亡并未让一直关注着蛟龙的情况的郑元雪察觉到，杨修的声音让郑元雪回过神来，在听到杨修话语的同时那柄她给杨修的剑便插在了他身前的地上，杨修的身影也从她的身旁闪过走向蛟龙那里。
虽说刚刚杨修刚刚对郑元雪说的话声音并不大，但是修士本身五感灵敏王虎众人也察觉到了杨修的靠近，赶忙从蛟龙的四周汇聚到了杨修的对面。
这章没有结束，请点击下一页继续阅读！
杨修走到蛟龙身边，蛟龙虚弱的趴在地上，身上的伤口还在往外渗出鲜血，他从储物戒中取出一枚丹药，扔入蛟龙口中，这枚丹药是在灵犀峡谷郑元雪给他的，那时郑元雪以为他也受伤了，后来他跟郑元雪说自己没受伤，郑元雪也没将丹药要回去，本来想着派不上用场，现在倒是合适。
“朋友，我们无冤无仇为什么要杀我们的人？”王虎刚刚面对蛟龙的时候根本没有看到杨修杀害汪强，现在站在杨修对面的位置，自然一眼看到了倒在地上的汪强愤怒的开口。
本来一脸平静的杨修讥笑开口“你们把我们的人绑起来还将这家伙伤的这么严重你说我们无冤无仇，今日你们都走不了！”
杨修话落气势散发在他身前的悬浮的龙血剑便向王虎等人飞去，他现在的御剑术只能支持他操控一柄剑。
王虎见杨修人未动剑却杀了过来心中大惊赶忙持剑抵挡攻击，龙血剑本身就吸收了真龙精血，现在经过杨修灵宝的淬炼之后锋利程度更甚，一剑便将王虎的重剑剑身洞穿，王虎见状身形暴退重剑也被他扔下。
杨修在操控龙血剑洞穿重剑之后并未追击身形后退的王虎，反而是一道剑气斩向了刚刚王虎侧身的路一山和叶安两人，这道剑气携带者真龙气势锐利无比，叶安和路一山还没来得及抵抗便与汪强团聚了，反倒是林小娜在王虎不敌的第一时间赶忙和王虎一起逃跑。
杨修没打算放过这一行人，对着身后的郑元雪说了句“照顾一下蛟龙我杀了他们就回来！”

content_en:
"Brother Tiger, don't wait any longer and just surround and kill this dragon!" said a person in the hunting team.
Wang Hu nodded and said to the little man, "Wang Qiang, watch that woman while we deal with this dragon."
After saying this, Wang Hu moved forward with a heavy sword. The members of the hunting team also followed him and set up a formation, surrounding the dragon from four directions.
Seeing this, Zheng Yuanxue hurriedly took out the Spirit Recovery Pill from the storage ring and wanted to throw it to Jiaolong to restore his spiritual energy. However, before he could throw it out, the little Wang Qiang came over and stood between her and Jiaolong. Then he appeared next to Zheng Yuanxue in a flash. He took out the rope from the storage ring and tied Zheng Yuanxue's hands. Although Zheng Yuanxue was tied up, there was nothing he could do if he wanted to struggle. Ordinary people were still too weak in front of the monks. When Wang Qiang tied Zheng Yuanxue with a rope, he saw Yang Xiu lying on the ground. Although he was a little confused, seeing that the person was unconscious, he turned his attention to the main battlefield without thinking.
"Brother Tiger, let's drag his limbs and attack him!" A woman in the hunting team said to Brother Tiger.
Wang Hu held the heavy sword tightly and stood in front of the dragon and said, "Okay! Xiaona, please pay more attention. Although this dragon is injured, it is still quite strong."
"Okay" Lin Xiaona responded with a long whip in her hand and whipped it towards the dragon.
When Jiaolong saw the four people approaching, he first used his tail to repel the enemy holding a long sword behind him, and then waved his uninjured right claw to grab the enemy holding a sword on the left.
When the man on the left saw this, the knife he originally stabbed was held in front of him to block the dragon's attack. He had the lowest cultivation level among the hunting team except Wang Qiang. The dragon's attack made him take a few steps back, with the smell of rust in his mouth and throat.
Lin Xiaona, who was on the right side of Jiaolong, saw Jiaolong swinging his left paw to attack Ye An on the right. The whip that was originally aimed at Jiaolong's left paw hit Jiaolong's back and bounced away. Seeing this, Lin Xiaona swung the whip again and whipped it back at Jiaolong.
Wang Hu was different from the others. He raised his heavy sword and struck directly at the dragon's head. The dragon then bit his heavy sword and shook his head, throwing the heavy sword and Wang Hu away. Wang Hu was the strongest among the four. Although he was thrown away, he quickly stabilized his body.
When Jiaolong was repelling Brother Tiger, he discovered Lin Xiaona, who was attacking again. The whip she had hit her on the highly defensive back scales just now made him feel like it was tickling, but the second whip struck its abdomen, and this whip was more powerful than the previous whip. The brain judged that it could not be hit by this whip, and then waved its tail to resolve the whip and whipped her tail towards Lin Xiaona.
Upon seeing this, Lin Xiaona quickly retreated to avoid the attack. The feeling of the tail just now made her heart palpitate. Although she missed, the strong wind it brought made her clear that the strength of this dragon was stronger than what they had inferred. She looked at Brother Hu.
The dragon's attack just now made everyone in the hunting team feel uneasy.
Unlike the hunting team, the dragon became more confident after neutralizing the attack, but he didn't want to fight fiercely so he said, "If you retreat now, you can save your life!"
Wang Hu laughed when he heard Jiaolong's voice and said, "When our hunting team hunts monsters, it's a knife-edge licking blood. Xiaona, stop attacking, use the whip to control its left paw, Lu Yishan controls his tail, I control his head, Ye An, you attack this time."
Lin Xiaona heard Wang Hu's words combined with the attack just now and deduced that the abdomen is the dragon's weak point, so she added, "Ye An, attack its abdomen where it is its weak point."
When Ye An heard Wang Hu and Lin Xiaona's words, he reached out and wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and responded loudly, "I know!"
The attack just now caused Wang Qiang, who had controlled Zheng Yuanxue, to say, "Brother Hu, do you want me to help you surround him?"
Wang Hu heard Wang Qiang's words and said, "No, your mission is to keep an eye on that woman!"
After the previous communication, the four of them took action at the same time. Lin Xiaona used her whip to control the dragon's left paw. Lu Yishan and Wang Hu cut off the dragon's head andThe tail attack forced Jiaolong to use his tail and mouth to deal with the two of them. Ye An on the right came to Jiaolong easily and swung his knife to attack Jiaolong's abdomen. Jiaolong's right claw was injured but he did not completely lose the ability to deal with the attack. The knife finally hit Jiaolong's abdomen, and Jiaolong struggled with a cry of pain. With increased strength, her left paw flung away Lin Xiaona's whip and attacked Ye An. Ye An did not miss a single blow and stepped back out of the dragon's attack range. Upon seeing this, Lin Xiaona swung her whip towards the dragon's face, trying to hit the dragon's eyes, but the dragon's head moved and the blow hit the nose.
Wang Hu was very happy to see that the attack was effective. He kept attacking with the heavy sword in his hand and shouted, "The attack is effective! Lu Yishan and I will continue as usual. Lin Xiaona and Ye An, you two, attack at the right time!"
Jiaolong was constantly injured under the siege, which made Zheng Yuanxue, who was tied up at the side, extremely uneasy. Wang Qiang beside him was very happy to see that the team had the upper hand, with a smile on his face.
"Huh~" Yang Xiu, who was lying on the ground, took a deep breath and slowly opened his eyes and stood up. What came into view was the tied up Zheng Yuanxue and the besieged dragon. He quickly stood up, and the dragon blood sword embryo in his hand transformed from the sword embryo into a sword just like in his consciousness.
The sound of Yang Xiu getting up startled Wang Qiang. Before Wang Qiang could open his mouth, a sword struck his head in the air and fell to the ground. Then Yang Xiu's voice came from behind Zheng Yuanxue, "Use this sword to cut the rope first and I will support Jiaolong!"
Wang Qiang had just died beside Zheng Yuanxue, but Zheng Yuanxue, who had been paying attention to Jiaolong's situation, did not notice it. Yang Xiu's voice brought Zheng Yuanxue back to her senses. When she heard Yang Xiu's words, the sword she gave Yang Xiu was inserted into the ground in front of him, and Yang Xiu's figure flashed past her and walked towards Jiaolong.
Although what Yang Xiu just said to Zheng Yuanxue was not loud, the monk himself with sensitive five senses, Wang Hu and others also noticed Yang Xiu's approach and hurriedly gathered from all around the dragon to the opposite side of Yang Xiu.

Yang Xiu walked to Jiaolong, who was lying weakly on the ground, with blood still oozing from the wounds on his body. He took out an elixir from the storage ring and threw it into Jiaolong's mouth. This elixir was given to him by Zheng Yuanxue in Lingxi Canyon. At that time, Zheng Yuanxue thought he was also injured. Later, he told Zheng Yuanxue that he was not injured, and Zheng Yuanxue did not ask for the elixir back. He originally thought that it would not be used, but now it is suitable.
"Friend, why do we want to kill our people when we have no grievances?" When Wang Hu just faced Jiaolong, he didn't see Yang Xiu killing Wang Qiang at all. Now standing opposite Yang Xiu, he naturally saw Wang Qiang who fell on the ground speaking angrily.
Yang Xiu, who had a calm face at first, sneered and said, "You tied up our people and injured this guy so seriously. You said we have no grievances and no grudges. You can't leave today!"
After Yang Xiu finished speaking, the suspended dragon blood sword spread out in front of him and flew towards Wang Hu and others. His current sword control skills could only support him to control one sword.
Wang Hu was shocked when he saw that Yang Xiuren had killed him without moving his sword, and he quickly held his sword to resist the attack. The Dragon Blood Sword itself absorbed the essence and blood of the real dragon, and now it was even sharper after being tempered by Yang Xiuren's Lingbao. With one sword, he pierced the body of Wang Hu's epee. When Wang Hu saw this, he retreated and threw the epee away.
After Yang Xiu manipulated the Dragon Blood Sword to pierce the epee, he did not pursue Wang Hu who was retreating. Instead, he slashed at Lu Yishan and Ye An, who were just beside Wang Hu, with a sword energy. The true dragon aura carried by this sword energy was extremely sharp. Ye An and Lu Yishan reunited with Wang Qiang before they could resist. On the contrary, Lin Xiaona hurriedly ran away with Wang Hu as soon as Wang Hu was defeated.
Yang Xiu had no intention of letting this group of people go, and said to Zheng Yuanxue behind him, "Take care of the dragon. I'll kill them and come back!"
